_readme: Curated list of open datasets for training a from-scratch SLM in the class of SmolLM / TinyLlama / Phi. Every entry is downloaded over plain HTTPS with no API key. Use fetch_datasets.py --plan/--only to resolve pinned shards; enabled entries remain legacy defaults. Licenses and upstream content rights must be reviewed before redistribution or commercial use.

datasets.name: FineWeb2 Vietnamese (bounded train shards)
datasets.description: Vietnamese web pretrain supplement; retain attribution, filter PII/noise and keep below Wikipedia/educational quality weighting.

datasets.name: SmolLM FineWeb-Edu deduplicated (bounded train shards)
datasets.description: Educational English breadth for a small LM; do not download the whole corpus.

datasets.name: Smol-SmolTalk short small-model conversations
datasets.description: Shorter instruction/chat data for small models; use TRAIN only, never test split.

datasets.name: NVIDIA OpenCodeInstruct (tested samples, train shard)
datasets.description: Filter to upstream full test score; metadata is upstream evidence, not locally re-executed code.

datasets.name: TinyStories v2 (GPT-4 generated)
datasets.description: Synthetic simple English stories. Useful early fluency data; keep low weight in continued training to avoid crowding out knowledge/VI/code.

datasets.name: TinyStories v2 validation
datasets.description: Small held-out slice of TinyStories v2.

datasets.name: Databricks Dolly 15k
datasets.description: 15k human-written instruction/response pairs across 7 categories.

datasets.name: Stanford Alpaca 52k
datasets.description: 52k instruction/input/output triples. Non-commercial license: fine for personal research.

datasets.name: GSM8K grade-school math (train)
datasets.description: 7.5k grade-school word problems with step-by-step solutions. Gold standard for SLM math.

datasets.name: CodeAlpaca 20k
datasets.description: 20k instruction/response pairs for coding tasks.

datasets.name: OpenAssistant OASST2
datasets.description: Tens of thousands of human-written multi-turn assistant conversations in 30+ languages (including Vietnamese).

datasets.name: MetaMathQA 395k
datasets.description: 395k augmented math word problems. Big improvement in reasoning; ~250 MB file.

datasets.name: Bactrian-X Vietnamese instructions
datasets.description: 67k Vietnamese instruction/input/output triples translated & natively collected. Best small VN instruction set.

datasets.name: LIMA (handcrafted 1k)
datasets.description: Only 1000 examples but famously high quality. Download may require you to be logged in and accept terms.

datasets.name: Cosmopedia v2 (first shard, SmolLM corpus)
datasets.description: Synthetic educational text in the spirit of Phi's 'Textbooks are all you need'. Repo moved to HuggingFaceTB/smollm-corpus (104 shards). Set enabled:true and install pyarrow to use.

datasets.name: OpenHermes 2.5 (first shard)
datasets.description: 1M curated instruction/chat examples. Enable and install pyarrow to use.

datasets.name: Simple English Wikipedia (HuggingFace cached)
datasets.description: Simple English Wikipedia, ~270k articles. Needs pyarrow.

datasets.name: Vietnamese Wikipedia (first shard)
datasets.description: Vietnamese Wikipedia shard 1/4, ~291 MB. Needs pyarrow.

datasets.name: Vietnamese Wikipedia (second shard)
datasets.description: Vietnamese Wikipedia shard 2/4, ~71 MB. Needs pyarrow.

datasets.name: Vietnamese Wikipedia (third shard)
datasets.description: Vietnamese Wikipedia shard 3/4, ~51 MB. Needs pyarrow.

datasets.name: Vietnamese Wikipedia (fourth shard)
datasets.description: Vietnamese Wikipedia shard 4/4, ~316 MB. Needs pyarrow. Full Vietnamese Wikipedia (~1.1M articles).
